notes: Supplementary config for workflows/restrict_master_spreadsheet.py (docs/trial-restriction.md), which writes a trial list for model_conditions.training.trial_restriction. Primary groups get exactly the same number of trials per subject; inside every primary group listed in secondary_applies_to, that number is split equally across the secondary groups. Example: 36 face (18 positive + 18 negative), 36 place (18 + 18) and 12 item trials -> 12 face (6 + 6), 12 place (6 + 6), 12 item. Queries are the usual column/match/and/or/not trees, evaluated per trial (an events.tsv row) over its own columns plus subject/session/task/run/boldfile/eventfile. Make the primary-group queries cover everything model_conditions.training selects, or the uncovered trials stay unbalanced (the script warns when you pass --config). Only training is restricted.
